data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher15/Fisher23, please help recruit. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.
